heat_transfer_correlation.source: Team-reported Incropera et al., Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 7th ed., section 8.5; range cross-checked against published Gnielinski usage. Exact licensed textbook page is not redistributed.

design_recommendation.source: SPACE Y team preliminary recommendation; not a Gnielinski validity limit or a proven fully-turbulent threshold

roughness_assessment.source: Team-reported Incropera rough-tube caution; corroborated as an approximate warning in secondary engineering literature, not implemented as a saturation law

colebrook_policy.domain_policy: Each run must supply a separately sourced friction domain; the Gnielinski range is not copied automatically.

limitations: Circular-tube friction and heat-transfer relations are approximated with hydraulic diameter.
Hydraulic diameter does not remove cross-sectional shape and aspect-ratio effects.
Fully developed flow is an input assertion requiring independent evidence.
The total wetted perimeter is not the same as the effective heated wall area.
